title: Country pack change record
description: Draft. The decoded body of one withdrawal, floor raise or follow-up closure of a country's pack index. CMP-038 writes it and lists it in the next index's changeRecords by id, kind and sha256 (the digest of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON); CMP-039 (the loader) must read it and check it. Per market only: a change names a country and a version or publish id, never a tenant. Unknown keys are refused. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are in x-validator-rules.
x-validator-rules: the two signOffs carry different signerId values and different mfa.assertionRef values, and each mfa.boundTo equals its own entry's signerId and statementDigest (signoff_same_person, signoff_mfa)
requestedBy equals one of the two signOffs' signerId

every signOff statementDigest equals this record's statementDigest, which is the digest of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {op: pack_change, countryCode, kind, target, reasonRef, baseIndexDigest} (signoff_statement_mismatch)

0 <= signedAt - mfa.authTime <= 300 seconds; every signedAt <= recordedAt; the accountant market equals countryCode; the signerSignature challenge is the domain-separated one of the publish record (country-pack-store.md assumption 4); roster and signerSignature checks are the publish record's (country-pack-record.schema.json)

baseIndexDigest is the digest of the exact payload bytes of the index with indexSeq equal to baseIndexSeq, and the index that lists this record has indexSeq baseIndexSeq plus 1 and that digest as predecessorDigest

withdrawal: target.version is published in the base index and is not its only published version; the version moves to withdrawn with reasonRef and any open follow-up for it is dropped. floor_raise: target.version is published and above the base floor. follow_up_closure: target.publishId is in the base followUpOpen

signOffs.description: Exactly two sign-offs, one market_accountant and one founder, in the publish record's format. Distinct people is an x-validator-rule.
